name: God The Father
overview: Scripture reveals God as the loving and sovereign Father who cares deeply for His children, exemplified by His compassion toward the fatherless and those in need (Psalms 68:5; 103:13). He is the Creator and Potter who shapes His people with intentionality and authority (Isaiah 64:8), and the one true Father in heaven whom believers are called to honor above all earthly relationships (Matthew 23:9). Through Christ, God the Father graciously bestows spiritual blessings, affirming His unique role in the believer's life and identity (Ephesians 1:3).
